title: A privately signed acceptance — Kendel v. Pontious
shortTitle: A privately signed acceptance — Kendel v. Pontious
summary: The notes describe signing an agreement without immediately communicating it to the other party.
notes: Did the offer make execution alone sufficient, or did it invite a communicated promise? Identify when the act of acceptance and any required notification occurred. Compare private intention with an act placed in a proper course of transmission.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 220–221. Open assigned page 220.
